## Objective

Recoverable Codex continuation leases

## Mode/Slice Decision

- scope_reason: bounded_structured_slice: one coherent outcome (a recoverable, non-self-blocking Codex continuation admission) inside the continuation module family of PR #84. quick_task is ineligible because a durable runtime record format and the dispatch admission contract change and an optional owner field may be added to bound next calls, so lease bounds, record migration and the owner mechanism must be fixed in SD; verified_change is ineligible (several owners: admission module, dispatch runtime, run command service, activity hook). No full-depth trigger: the record lives in the plugin data folder of the same build, consumers are only in this repository, no authority, permission or release boundary, failure stays local. Rejected alternative: structured_delivery. Required next gate: PRD.
